# The Principal Playbook

> Official website of Dr. Michael Bishop — school leadership expert, author, keynote speaker, consultant, and principal coach.

Site: https://theprincipalplaybook.com
Canonical: https://theprincipalplaybook.com/
Sitemap: https://theprincipalplaybook.com/sitemap.xml

## Summary

The Principal Playbook provides practical leadership strategies, educational resources, principal coaching, keynote speaking, consulting services, and professional development for school principals, administrators, and education leaders.
